description: Resolve a ticker, company name or CIK to the canonical company (name, ticker, CIK, FIGI), confirming which company a name means before other tools run. Use when the user asks: which company is X; what's the ticker for X; is X listed. Args: query.

query.description: A company name, ticker or SEC CIK to identify; returns its name, ticker, CIK and FIGI.
query.title: Query
